limitations: Single consumer PC with shared desktop GPU; no CXL hardware.
Float32 dense attention retains all entries; this is not a reproduction of sparse HGCA/BEYOND.
GPU allocation is a PyTorch allocator observation, not exclusive physical VRAM residency.
Finite numerical agreement does not establish downstream language quality.

protocol.comparison: same teacher-forced native greedy token history for every method
protocol.timing: synchronized wall time including cache append, eviction and transfers
protocol.quality_scope: finite full-vocabulary logit checks; no downstream quality benchmark
protocol.prefill: native causal SDPA for all methods; offload/cache preparation included in prefill time
protocol.cache_window: Hybrid fractions set the initial prompt's GPU window; that token window stays fixed during decoding.
